inbox.title: Inbox
inbox.body: Letters from offices and confirmations of your matters will arrive here. Your inbox is empty for now.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.body: Here you'll see reminders about deadlines, for example when your ID card expires. Nothing is waiting for now.

assistant.title: Assistant
assistant.body: Here you'll type or say what you need. The assistant will guide you step by step and ask you to confirm before it sends anything.
